image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a laminated restaurant menu. The menu features a large central photograph of a dish (appearing to be a curry or stew with bread/toast) inside a white bowl. Above the photo is the restaurant name 'Baba Nyonya' in stylized red and green typography with Chinese characters. Below the photo are text descriptions and prices. The menu is encased in a clear plastic sleeve, visible by the reflections and the edge of another menu page on the right.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a distinct header ('Baba Nyonya') with larger, stylized font, followed by smaller body text for item descriptions, establishing a clear hierarchy.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom text block describing the dish
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text below the food image is illegible and appears to be 'AI-generated gibberish'—it mimics the shape of letters and words but does not form coherent readable strings upon close inspection. This is a common artifact in AI-generated documents.

artifact_observations.location: Food image within the circular frame
artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the food (specifically the brown triangular pieces) appears slightly waxy and overly smooth, lacking the fine granular detail expected in high-resolution food photography. It has a 'painted' look.

artifact_observations.location: Right edge of the menu / Plastic sleeve boundary
artifact_observations.reasoning: The transition between the menu edge and the adjacent plastic sleeve/page on the right is slightly ambiguous and soft, lacking a sharp, physically accurate boundary definition.

Realism of the specular highlights on the laminated surface.
Structural integrity of the food image (does it look like plausible food?).
Sharpness of the menu's physical edges against the background.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In AI-generated menus, text often looks correct at a glance but fails OCR or logical scrutiny. If the image_text_auditor confirms the text is nonsensical, this is a significant structural defect for a 'menu' class, which relies on information transmission. Also, evaluate if the food image looks like a real photograph pasted in or if it shares the same generative artifacts as the rest of the image.
